source_evidence: Blocking: src/jev_factorio/lua/fair_actions.lua lines 176 and 185 call fair.actor() without assigning its returned LuaPlayer, then dereference the unrelated global player.surface. Factorio supplies the player through game.get_player(1), not this test-only global, so bounded resource discovery fails with attempt to index a nil value (global 'player') before it can populate fair_resource_targets.

The added discovery test masks this failure: tests/test_fair_actions.py creates player as a Lua global (line 72) and test_generated_terrain_discovery_does_not_select_or_control_the_player invokes discovery while that global remains present (lines 133-145). A runtime-shaped Lua harness with only game.get_player(1) reproduced the nil-global failure at fair_actions.lua line 185.

The intended fairness guards remain present in source: fair.actor() requires the original connected character, game.speed == 1, and cheat_mode false; begin_mine independently enforces can_reach_entity and cursor selection before setting mining_state. The defect prevents the newly required bounded discovery from reaching that existing fair harvest path.
